scenarios.description: Atlas prod has two customer-api and two customer-web digests with different runtime/library versions.
Lambda supplies python3.11 / python3.12 only; its SBOM describes code libraries, not an exact managed runtime patch.
Harbor EC2 versions are installed software observations. App tags do not attest which binaries the application executes.
Beacon report-builder prod has a known build manifest but no captured SBOM artifact.
A second report-builder prod task has an unrecognized digest, despite using a familiar image tag.
Harbor UAT has an image tag but no observed digest; no version is inferred from a latest build.
NumPy in Beacon UAT is recorded without a version or versioned purl.
An orphan ECS task has no business application/project tags and remains unassigned.
